PROJECT 01 — FLAGSHIP

Multi-Agent AI Research Assistant

PROJECT 02 — VOICE + PERSONA

Mirror AI — AI Persona Generator

What if an assistant didn’t just answer like an AI — but wrote like you? Mirror AI learns and replicates a user’s writing style from their own uploaded documents.

A multi-agent assistant combining LLM + document processing + STT/TTS, so you can talk to a persona that sounds — and writes — like the person it learned from. NiceGUI frontend.

PROJECT 03 — TRUST & RECORDS

Blockchain-Based Property Registration

Property records fail when they can be quietly changed. This system makes transactions secure, transparent, and auditable — every step on an immutable record.

Built around a multi-role approval flow — buyer, seller, and authority each play their part before a registration is final. No single party can push a record through alone.
